label: help_sim_teleop_agent
command: docker exec s2r-sim s2r-entrypoint python -m sim.teleop.agent --help
output:
usage: agent.py [-h] [--config_path str] [--arm str] [--scene str]
                [--task str] [--variant [str]] [--num_envs [int]]
                [--use_fabric bool] [--seed int] [--fps int]
                [--calibrate bool] [--control_input {terminal,keyboard}]
                [--spawn_port int] [--spawn_authkey str]
                [--sim_reset_object_name [str]]
                [--sim_reset_object_offset float float float] [--leader str]
                [--leader.port str] [--leader.id str] [--follower str]
                [--follower.enabled bool] [--follower.port str]
                [--follower.id str] [--follower.unit [str]]
                [--follower.cameras dict[str,str]]
                [--follower.camera_width int] [--follower.camera_height int]
                [--follower.camera_fourcc [str]] [--dataset str]
                [--dataset.repo_id [str]] [--dataset.root [str]]
                [--dataset.task_name [str]] [--dataset.real_repo_id [str]]
                [--dataset.real_root [str]]
                [--dataset.on_alignment_mismatch {error,new}]
                [--dataset.save_mp4 bool] [--dataset.depth bool]
                [--dataset.instance_id_seg bool]
                [--dataset.image_writer_threads_per_camera int]
                [--telemetry str] [--telemetry.joint_angle_log [str]]
                [--gui str] [--gui.enabled bool] [--gui.host str]
                [--gui.port int] [--gui.fps float]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config_path str     Path for a config file to parse with draccus (default:
                        None)
  --leader str          Config file for leader (default: None)
  --leader str          Config file for leader (default: None)
  --follower str        Config file for follower (default: None)
  --follower str        Config file for follower (default: None)
  --dataset str         Config file for dataset (default: None)
  --dataset str         Config file for dataset (default: None)
  --telemetry str       Config file for telemetry (default: None)
  --telemetry str       Config file for telemetry (default: None)
  --gui str             Config file for gui (default: None)
  --gui str             Config file for gui (default: None)

AgentConfig:

  --arm str             
  --scene str           
  --task str            
  --variant [str]
  --num_envs [int]
  --use_fabric bool     
  --seed int            
  --fps int             
  --calibrate bool      False connects both arms with calibration refused (v1
                        --no_calibration). (default: True)
  --control_input {terminal,keyboard}
  --spawn_port int      Local spawn.py listener; 0 disables it. (default:
                        6001)
  --spawn_authkey str   
  --sim_reset_object_name [str]
                        Existing scene entity placed at the simulated gripper
                        when an episode starts. (default: None)
  --sim_reset_object_offset float float float

LeaderConfig ['leader']:

  --leader.port str     
  --leader.id str       

FollowerConfig ['follower']:

  --follower.enabled bool
                        False keeps sim-only teleop; the physical follower and
                        its cameras stay closed. (default: False)
  --follower.port str   
  --follower.id str     
  --follower.unit [str]
  --follower.cameras dict[str,str]
                        name -> OpenCV index or /dev/video path. Opened only
                        when recording a real dataset. (default: {'gripper':
                        '/dev/video6', 'external': '/dev/video4'})
  --follower.camera_width int
  --follower.camera_height int
  --follower.camera_fourcc [str]

DatasetConfig ['dataset']:

  --dataset.repo_id [str]
                        Recording is on when repo_id, root and task_name are
                        all set. (default: None)
  --dataset.root [str]
  --dataset.task_name [str]
  --dataset.real_repo_id [str]
                        Real-follower dataset; defaults to "<repo_id>-real" /
                        "<root>-real". (default: None)
  --dataset.real_root [str]
  --dataset.on_alignment_mismatch {error,new}
  --dataset.save_mp4 bool
  --dataset.depth bool  
  --dataset.instance_id_seg bool
  --dataset.image_writer_threads_per_camera int

TelemetryConfig ['telemetry']:

  --telemetry.joint_angle_log [str]
                        New JSONL path for passive follower / mapped / sim
                        joint-angle telemetry; needs the follower. (default:
                        None)

GuiConfig ['gui']:

  --gui.enabled bool    v1 browser recorder at http://<host>:<port>/ (sim and
                        real camera panes, start/save/discard/spawn, re-record
                        a saved episode). Kept until the new GUI replaces it.
                        (default: False)
  --gui.host str        0.0.0.0 to reach it from another machine. (default:
                        127.0.0.1)
  --gui.port int        
  --gui.fps float       Preview refresh limit, not the dataset fps; 0 means
                        every tick. (default: 15.0)
